description: This apartment is located in the center of the city, close to Louvre museum and Marais neighborhood. It was fully redesigned with a contemporary touch, making it a vibrant and colorful haven to unwind after a long day of exploring Paris. The noble materials and careful design convey a luxury feel to the apartment. Each of the bedrooms offers comfort and intimacy, and the living room is an inviting space to share unforgettable moments.The spaceNeed to store your luggage? We can help arrange its pickup before your arrival and after your departure, contact us!Important: No elevator in the building - the apartment is accessible through the stairs on the 1st floor.The apartment includes:- 1 Living room- 1 Dining rooms with 8 seats- 1 Fully equipped kitchen- 1 Shared bathroom (shower and WC)- 2 Private bathrooms (see below)- 1 Separate WC4 bedrooms arranged as follows:- Bedroom 1 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (shower, no WC)- Bedroom 2 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (bathtub, no WC)- Bedroom 3 with a Queensize bed- Bedroom 4 with a double bed- Living room convertible into a bedroom: 1 sofa bed for two peopleThe apartment is ideal for 8 people and can accommodate up to 10 peopleLa superficie de l'appartement est de 97m² / 1044ft² The apartment is equipped with:- Bath and bed linen- 5-star bedding - Toiletries (shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, toilet paper)- High speed Wifi- TV- Washer dryer - Hair dryer- Nespresso coffee machine- Water boiler- Toaster - Fridge- Induction cooking plates- Combined microwave oven- Pans and other cooking wares- Baby bed and high chair if needed- SafeWe have curated a selection of services and experiences with trusted partners to elevate your Parisian stay. From a private Chef preparing a meal in your apartme

enrichment.summary: Four-bedroom, 97 m² apartment with 4 fixed beds plus a sofa bed, 2 toilets, a separate shower and an en-suite shower; another en-suite has a bathtub. The listing says the apartment is up stairs on the first floor with no lift, which makes access unsuitable for avoiding flights.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: A broad, colourful view of the living room communicates the apartment's style and the main shared space.
issues: The listing explicitly places the apartment on the first floor and says access is by stairs with no elevator.
The living room sofa bed is extra sleeping capacity and is excluded from the proper-bed count.

themes: Several of the 10 reviews praise the central location and convenient access to shops, restaurants and transit.
Several reviews describe a comfortable, attractive and well-equipped apartment; guests often praise the host's communication.
concerns: One review reports an occasional stuffy smell in the innermost room.
One guest mentions weekend street noise; one guest points out that there is no air conditioning for summer stays.
